lanes.title: Make the generic admission scope lock fail fast (FOR SHARE NOWAIT) like the legacy path
lanes.description: Authoritative: Linear issue OVD-628 (re-scoped 2026-10-05 17:30Z) plus the OVD-598 coordinator decision comments c0997604, d0162954, 317c7134 (the legacy-path design this unit mirrors). Summary: the generic admission path api_request_provider_dispatch (scope row locks defined in the stacked migration 20261003160000:409-424 and successors, in PR #573/#574 of the #564 stack) still waits on row locks in parts-requirements-files order and cycles with the worker RPC api_register_trusted_file_hash, with the requirement writers (api_reset_client_part_property_overrides, api_approve_job_requirements, api_auto_approve_job_requirements), with api_cancel_quote_request and with api_delete_project. Apply the OVD-598 construction: one new migration stacked after OVD-601's 138 and OVD-598's 137 that redefines the generic admission's scope-lock block so that, before validation and only on the non-replay path, it takes NOWAIT locks on every row it reads or later writes at sufficient strength (job FOR NO KEY UPDATE; parts, requirements, job_files FOR SHARE; the job's service_request_line_items row FOR NO KEY UPDATE; the job's project FOR KEY SHARE; NO organization or auth.users locks), mapping SQLSTATE 55P03 to P0001 provider_dispatch_job_busy. Everything else byte-for-byte; security settings, search_path, revoke/grant restated unchanged. Replay/dedup lookup must run before the lock block (as #580 does). State the invariant precisely (after the NOWAIT block the request waits only on the founding-beta shared advisory lock, with the holder condition, plus implicit KEY SHARE on org/user FK parents during inserts whose conflicting holders are admin-only). Adapt the generic-path lifecycle-race expectations the way #580 did for the legacy path; re-pin the closed free-quote CI profile (count and content hashes). Add a dblink race suite R1-R7 mirroring supabase/tests/xometry_beta_dispatch_admission_serialization.sql at the #580 head (editor-first fail-fast; request-first editors wait; worker trusted-hash; overrides reset; cancel; delete project; replay-while-busy returns the dedup result). Client: map provider_dispatch_job_busy to the same retry copy as xometry_beta_job_busy, keep uncertain-replay recovery, with unit tests. Red run first against the current definition (PR #595's closed race suite and the #580 R3-R7 shapes are the references).
files: src/features/quotes/<existing provider dispatch error mapping + tests>
lanes.guidance: Base = the OVD-601 branch claude/server-empty-file-upload-rejection (PR #592), which already contains #580's NOWAIT migration via merge-forward; fetch the current tip first. Lockfile family #564: /home/user/wt/base564 symlinks. Study #580's final migration 20261004100000 (helper + handler + lookup order), its race suite and static test, and copy the patterns exactly. Migration timestamp 20261004130000 (after 138). Do NOT reorder any writer. Sonar: byte-for-byte restate may trip S1192/CPD; one sonar.cpd.exclusions line for this migration is coordinator-sanctioned if the duplication gate is red; grouped dispositions in the PR body. ensure-docker.sh then `supabase status`; DB work under /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock; keep locked sections short; never kill processes you did not start. Never write the release-parent identifiers listed in ENV.md; never use Linear closing words (fix/close/resolve) before any issue identifier in the PR body. Open a DRAFT PR with base claude/server-empty-file-upload-rejection, title starting OVD-628:, body per the template, stating the merge order (#580, #592, then this PR) and that production apply is protected.
lanes.failure_first: Red at the base tip: race suite against the current generic definition shows 40P01 in the worker (R3) and overrides-reset (R4) interleavings (excerpts recorded). Green after the migration: R1-R7 pass, no 40P01 on either side anywhere, replay-while-busy returns the dedup result. Mutations on scratch copies only: remove NOWAIT from one lock -> the matching race reproduces 40P01; move the lock block before the dedup lookup -> replay returns busy.
lanes.verification: flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local supabase/tests/provider_dispatch_admission_serialization.sql'; full supabase test db --local under the lock (capability_runtime_persistence_concurrency.sql is environment-only); the existing provider dispatch permits/preflight (and concurrency) suites and the OVD-598 suite unchanged; npx vitest on the new static test and the client mapping tests; node --test scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.node-test.mjs scripts/free-quote-psql-races.node-test.mjs; node scripts/generate-free-quote-fixtures.mjs --check; npm run verify:migration-lineage; npm run lint && npm run typecheck; flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify (browserRecovery.test.ts root-sandbox failure is a known baseline; run build and verify:worker separately). Hosted (authoritative): free-quote-sql, test, ovd591 jobs, Sonar at the PR head.
